title: Boss: The Endless Search
story: This binary search sometimes loops forever and sometimes misses an item that is really there.
goal: Fix binary_search so it finds every item and always stops.
hints: Two bugs. One makes the loop stop too early when low and high meet. The other fails to shrink the range, so it can repeat forever.
Use while low <= high, and move low to mid + 1 (not mid).
socratic: What happens when low and high are the same position?
Does low = mid shrink the range when mid equals low?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
